descriptor: Weekly letter on craft, cities and small tools

voice.summary: Sounds like a friend's long, well-edited email: curious, a little wry and in no rush. It recommends one thing worth the walk and trusts readers to follow a tangent.
dos: Open with a specific object, person or street
Give reading time and issue number
End each issue with one recommendation
donts: Do not use growth-newsletter phrases like unmissable
Do not pad issues with filler links

taglines: A weekly letter, worth the walk
Read slowly, think a little longer
boilerplate: The Slow Dispatch is a weekly letter on craft, cities and small tools, with a featured essay, reader questions and one recommendation worth walking to, archived back to its first issue.
